title: Dream team
kind: 说明文 · 梦之队的含义与各国的梦之队

timeline.text: At the 1992 Olympics, the US basketball team won the gold medal. People called it the dream team.
Nowadays a dream team refers to the greatest team in its field.
There have been many dream teams throughout the history of sports.
Canada’s dream team plays on ice — it’s the country’s ice hockey team.
For Brazil, it might be the men’s volleyball or soccer team.
What is China’s dream team? Many people would think of the diving team.
China also has dream teams in ping-pong and weight lifting. Time after time, these teams have won gold medals for China.
However, there is more to a dream team than winning gold medals.
A dream team has not only the best players and the best coach, but also the best team spirit.
All of the players must work hard and cooperate with one another.
By working together, they show their courage and their drive. They never give up. That’s what makes a dream team!
The spirit of a dream team influences lots of people everywhere, not only in their home nation.
People admire and feel proud of their dream team.
